svg.title: Multus CNI thick plugin DaemonSet mode architecture
svg.desc: Shows containerd calling a lightweight multus-shim which connects via Unix socket to the long-running multus-daemon DaemonSet, which uses an informer cache to look up NADs and fork-execs delegate CNI plugins
svg.text: Thin 模式：每次 Pod 创建冷启动，直接 list NAD（API Server 压力大）
Thick 模式：informer cache 本地命中，无 per-Pod API call，适合高密度节点
